chunks: Al-Ḥalabī narrated from him, عليه السلام, that he said:
"If you perform any of the prayers during travel outside its time, it will not harm you."

key_terms.السَّفَرِ: travel; the state of being on a journey

ai.seo_question: Is it harmful to perform a prayer during travel outside its usual time?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling related to salat during travel. It indicates leniency regarding performing a prayer in travel outside its usual time, and that doing so does not bring harm or fault.
